The test image shows a tomato stem with dense white cottony mycelium covering a stem section at a node, with small black structures (sclerotia) visible on the white growth. The right side shows bleached/dead stem tissue. This strongly points to **Sclerotinia_Timber_Rot**.

Let me view one reference image to confirm.

The reference confirms the match. Both show bleached stem tissue with black sclerotia embedded in white fungal growth. The test image has more active white cottony mycelium (fresh infection), but the diagnostic features are identical: white mycelium + black sclerotia on the stem.
